notes.title: Fixed more bugs.
notes.content:
-Fixed a few more bugs.
-Made control scheme more accessible, as simple as they are.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
-Added character interactions to dog, owl, and cat.
-Fixed a few small but crucial bugs in different modes.

notes.title: Power-Up timers
notes.content:
Added power-up timers for leaf and feather.
Power-up duration is now refreshed to 30 sec, not limited to 30 secs.

notes.title: Tiny patch to put cat back into original mode.
notes.content: Cat was missing from original mode.

notes.title: Original Mode
notes.content: Added sort of new/old mode, just giving the option of playing the original version of the game with no pesky dog or owl to impede your nut collecting, score building fun :)

notes.title: Minor interface changes
notes.content:
- all scroll boxes are navigable with a gamepad.
- high score and rank are on game screen in progressive mode.
- other minor navigation changes.

notes.title: Minor interface change
notes.content: added global rank and score to game screen.

notes.title: The price of Dee's Nuts 2 is too damn high!
notes.content: Today I have permanently reduced the price of Dee's Nuts 2 to 99 cents USD.  Don't be afraid to leave feedback on the game under this post, or in a review.  Thank you.

notes.title: Normal mode scoreboard has been reset.
notes.content: Normal mode scoreboard has been reset due to change in difficulty since the introduction of the dog and owl to the game.  Good luck everyone.  Thank you for playing :)

notes.title: Couple more achievements and a bug fix.
notes.content:
-Added two more achievements.
-Game should properly upload and set score when dying to dog or owl.

notes.title: The jump button is your friend!
notes.content:
-Added a few more obstacles.
-Might have to re-disable tutorial text.

notes.title: Tutorial text is now togglable.
notes.content: You can now show or hide in game tutorial text in the options menu.

notes.title: A couple more EXPLOSIONS!
notes.content: A couple more explosions that are more common to see...others are little more rare.

notes.title: Changed graphics settings.
notes.content: Changed graphics settings.  Removed Low graphics setting and added cinematic, which for this game really just runs your graphics card harder than needed with no to very little visual quality gain.

notes.title: Playing on Low graphics quality not advised
notes.content: Playing on Low graphics quality not advised.  I will attempt to fix in future but everything breaks on low quality
